svg.title: Trophy: Wrote the control plane. Center Point, the control plane of E-Jam, my graduation project, a test bench for network switches made by a team of five: a REST API in Rust on Actix Web. GitHub's history of Center Point's folder, pinned at commit 7e70afe, has 121 commits: 114 are mine (three of them merges of Dependabot's pull requests) and the other 7 are Dependabot's. I also built the Flutter admin app. Opens that history.
